__baseline_prompt__.text: A cinematic documentary photograph of a woman wearing wearable robotic equipment, caught in field work with robotic equipment on the service deck of a wind-battered rooftop greenhouse. Use the supplied reference for her visible facial appearance and dark bob haircut. Her face keeps the reference's soft oval shape, dark eyes and fine wispy fringe; wind lifts a few short strands across one cheek. Her quiet concentration and relaxed mouth give the working portrait a subtle personal warmth. A heavy relay-cabinet door has been bent by the storm. Its lower edge has just settled onto a low maintenance trestle while she holds its outer handle steady, keeping a wind-blown door from swinging back across her work. The open cabinet and its displaced hinge bracket remain immediately behind the door; one loose fastener and a short wrench rest on the trestle beside the lower corner. She is checking the upper hinge alignment, with her left fingertips placed on the cabinet-side hinge bracket. Her right hand encloses the door handle, her right elbow bent naturally. An articulated utility exoskeleton follows the outside of that right arm, with a padded upper-arm cuff, an elbow pivot, a forearm cuff and a shoulder support attached to a fitted torso harness. The right-arm assembly and her human wrist remain visually distinct. Her boots are planted apart on the wet nonslip deck, and the trestle carries the door's lower edge. She wears a weathered ochre work coverall, its functional waist and rolled cuffs following her movement. Broken cloud gives soft directional daylight, a warmer sunbreak briefly touching her cheek and the pale aluminum links. Wet greenhouse glass and rows of bowed green plants give the gust a visible consequence in the background. A close full-length vertical photograph from her front-right, with enough depth of field to keep her face, the complete arm support, the handle and both door hinges readable together. Real skin and work-worn mechanical surfaces, restrained color, a particular task caught in progress.
